evidence: KISS-ICP RegisterFrame estimates an ego-centric LiDAR pose.
With base_frame empty, the official ROS2 wrapper uses the input cloud frame as the moving frame and publishes lidar_odom_frame->cloud_frame.
The default lidar_odom_frame is odom_lidar and the benchmark Livox converter preserves the original input header frame.

benchmark_notes: LiDAR-only control baseline. The official ROS2 node consumes PointCloud2, so Livox CustomMsg bags use the benchmark-owned loss-minimizing converter with x/y/z plus t=offset_time. KISS local_map is a local debug map and is not labeled a Native global map. Its world gauge is the initial LiDAR odometry frame; it has no gravity observation and therefore cannot preserve a handheld sensor's absolute tilt relative to gravity.
